'''Level 10''' was a location in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].

==History==
The tenth of eleven levels comprising the sinkhole settlement of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], Level 10 was part of the civic level, closest to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. It featured a docking bay large enough to accommodate a [[core ship]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] landed a core ship on the Level 10 docking bay,<ref name="SWCL" /> to serve as their headquarters on Utapau. It was here that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] engaged [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in single combat. The level was soon overrun by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]].<ref name="RotS" />
